title: UpdateAnnouncer
description: Keep your players and Discord community up to date with every server change!
body:
📖 Description

UpdateAnnouncer is a simple yet powerful Minecraft plugin designed to help server owners communicate updates and changes to their players. Its main purpose is to provide a straightforward way to share announcements both in-game and optionally through Discord.

When installed, the plugin creates an UpdateAnnouncer folder with a config.yml file that allows full customization of update messages and Discord webhook settings. Server staff can run a command to display update notes in Minecraft chat, while Discord users can automatically receive the same announcements via a webhook.

This makes UpdateAnnouncer ideal for survival, SMP, and roleplay communities that want to keep everyone informed about new features, bug fixes, and other important news.

✅ Key Features

In-game announcement system for update notes.

Optional Discord integration via webhooks.

Fully customizable messages and formatting.

Lightweight and easy to set up, no unnecessary features.

Perfect for keeping both your Minecraft server and Discord community in sync.

⚙️ Example Use Case

Imagine you’ve just updated your spawn area and fixed an economy bug. Instead of relying only on Discord posts or word of mouth, you can use /update to instantly broadcast the news in-game, while automatically sending the same announcement to your Discord server. Everyone stays informed, no one misses out.
